name: James Minor Sr

bio.statement: Minor's pamphlet statement says he began his career as a technician for about 10 years.
bio.excerpt: I began my career as a technician, working in that field for approximately 10 years

bio.statement: Minor's pamphlet statement lists an associate degree in mathematics and physics from Macomb County Community College.
bio.excerpt: Associate degree from Macomb County Community College, with a major in Mathematics and Physics.

bio.statement: Minor's pamphlet statement says he served on the board of the King City Civic Association.
bio.excerpt: I served on the board of the King City Civic Association (KCCA)

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Minor says growth should be managed responsibly considering its impact on residents, taxes and infrastructure.
positions.excerpt: growth needs to be managed responsibly while considering its impact on residents, taxes, infrastructure

positions.statement: Minor's pamphlet statement says the council should build on previous councils' work rather than starting over.
positions.excerpt: I also believe we should build on the work of previous councils rather than continually starting over.

positions.statement: Minor's pamphlet statement says he will work collaboratively with council members, staff and residents.
positions.excerpt: As a council member, I will work collaboratively with the other council members, city staff, and residents.
